_about: The Proving Halls (levels 1-7), kept gentle: no boss and no waves. The mist-taken novices and the quasits help one of their own, the dark spectre is an elite, the massive Minotaur in the Red Room a sub-boss for new players to aim at, and a shambler wanders the first passages.
no_boss: kept gentle for new players: its DEADLY veteran is the lesson, not a boss

helpers.shout: The mist-taken novice groans, and another shambles over!
The quasit squeaks for a friend!

patrols.why: a newbie monster wanders the first passages
